# Sophos-website: what it can do, and how it got here

A nearly empty repository intended for the Sophos website; it holds only a title-only README and the synced Sophos skill.

## How we got here

Every change entry, newest first: what it was for, and what it made possible.

### 20261028-change-record-in-sophos-website

Task `change-record-deploy-repos-20261028`.

**Why.** Sophos-website had no record of why its code changes: a commit message keeps what changed, not why it mattered, and the reason lived only in the memory of whoever made it. Ken asked on 2026-10-27 for the household change record in every repository, tuned to each.

**Enables.** Every commit here now carries why it mattered and what it enables, judged when it is made, while the synced Sophos skill copy, whose why is recorded where it is authored, needs no entry.

**Untested:** This commit installs the gate here; the engine and this repository's tuning are tested in Project-Sophos, in admin/tests/change-record.test.mjs and admin/tests/change-record-deploy.test.mjs.
